chapter_seo_title: Chapter 477: Heartforce Breakthrough in the Realm of Annihilation - Desolate Era
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning reveals his heartforce has reached the Third Level, channeling it through sword-fingers. He endures a twelve-year siege as the Broken Horn World's whetstone, his divine power finally reaching the brink of transformation.
og_description: Ji Ning's heartforce ascends to the Third Level, a feat before even his tribulation. Then, twelve years of grinding combat pushes his divine power to the edge of godhood.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 477 - Heartforce at the Third Level
twitter_description: After wandering the dead Realm of Annihilation, Ji Ning's heartforce hits Mastery. He's thrown into a twelve-year slugfest against the Broken Horn World's elite.

lore_anchors.definition: A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; the Third Level allows projection through physical attacks.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
The "Mastery" tier of heartforce cultivation according to Houyi's five-level system; a realm usually achieved only by True Gods and Daofathers, granting near-causal attack potency.
The number one Fiendgod Body Refining technique; the Sixteenth Cycle represents the peak of Void-level power, and breaking through to the Seventeenth marks the final step toward Empyrean Godhood.
A peerless heartforce technique taught by Houyi that simultaneously trains the soul, the will, and the physical control of heartforce; Ji Ning's continuous practice of it during exile.
The peak physical stage before an Empyrean God tribulation; a cultivator's divine power and body are pushed to their theoretical limit in preparation for a qualitative leap.
Ancient, powerful beings born alongside the Primordial Pangu World who served Daoist Threelives; they possess deep knowledge of the Three Realms's power structure and heartforce levels.
An alien realm within the ancient ruins; its forces use Ji Ning as a living training dummy to sharpen their elite warriors, believing their own growth will outpace his.
The elite military caste of the Broken Horn World; each one is a formidable combatant in their own right, chosen to fight Ji Ning in one-on-one duels over twelve years.
The divine transformation achieved after a Fiendgod's tribulation; a being whose body and divine power undergo a fundamental, qualitative ascension, placing them far above any Void-level existence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Third Level of heartforce?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The "Mastery" tier in Houyi's five-level classification; it allows a cultivator to project their will into their physical attacks, bypassing conventional defenses and striking at the soul's connection to the Dao, usually only achieved by True Gods and Daofathers.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why do the Broken Horn World warriors let Ji Ning recover between fights?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are using him as a living whetstone to train their elite purple-caped warriors; they believe the value of tempering their own fighters outweighs the risk of letting Ji Ning grow stronger.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does reaching the Seventeenth Cycle of Crimsonbright Diagram matter so much?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It marks the final threshold before an Empyrean God's transformation; the divine power undergoes a qualitative shift in density and purity, pushing a Void-level body into a state that can nearly match a true god's raw physical might.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are the seven Fiendgods so shocked by Ji Ning's heartforce breakthrough?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They, being ancient beings born with the Primordial World, understand that heartforce mastery at his level, before his tribulation, is a feat only seen once in an age—it rewrites the entire power hierarchy of the Three Realms.
